question: How is DINOv3 different from DINO in what it emphasizes?
direct_answer: DINOv3 emphasizes dense patch-feature quality more strongly and scales model/data/compute, while DINO mainly established the self-distillation framework.
expanded_answer: DINO showed that teacher-student self-distillation can learn strong vision representations without labels. DINOv3 keeps that core idea but pushes harder on dense feature quality, using larger-scale training and gram anchoring so the representations are more useful for spatially detailed transfer tasks.
key_points: Scales model size, data, and compute
Adds anchoring to improve dense feature stability
common_wrong_ideas: Thinking DINOv3 is a completely unrelated method
Assuming scaling alone is the only change
